title.zh: 将布拉干省吉金托市镇圣丽塔中学的名称变更为Felizardo C. Lipana纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Sta. Rita High School in the Municipality of Guiguinto, Province of Bulacan, to Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Sta. Rita High School in the Municipality of Guiguinto, Province of Bulacan, to Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Sta. Rita tại Thị trấn Guiguinto, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường trung học phổ thông Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sta. Rita ในเทศบาล Guiguinto, จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Sta. Rita di Kotamadya Guiguinto, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Sta. Rita di Perbandaran Guiguinto, Wilayah Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7693_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sta. Rita High School, located in the Municipality of Guiguinto, Province of Bulacan, is hereby changed to Felizardo C. Lipana Memorial High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
